svg.title: Frontend state ownership connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Frontend state ownership.

a.xlink:title: Frontend state ownership. Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs. Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.
